#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
if ! command -v docker >/dev/null 2>&1; then export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive; apt-get update -qq && apt-get install -y -qq docker.io; command -v nvidia-ctk >/dev/null 2>&1 && nvidia-ctk runtime configure --runtime=docker; systemctl restart docker || service docker restart || true; fi
TOKEN=$(curl -sf -H 'Metadata-Flavor: Google' http://metadata.google.internal/computeMetadata/v1/instance/service-accounts/default/token | python3 -c 'import sys,json;print(json.load(sys.stdin)["access_token"])')
echo "$TOKEN" | docker login -u oauth2accesstoken --password-stdin us-central1-docker.pkg.dev
docker pull IMAGE_URI
docker run --rm --gpus all --shm-size=4g -e INPUT_GCS="${INPUT_GCS}" -e OUTPUT_GCS_PREFIX="${OUTPUT_GCS_PREFIX}" -e MODEL_GCS="${MODEL_GCS}" -e MAX_NEW_TOKENS="${MAX_NEW_TOKENS}" -e BATCH_SIZE="${BATCH_SIZE}" -e MAX_CHARS="${MAX_CHARS}" -e MAX_MODEL_LEN="${MAX_MODEL_LEN}" -e TOP_K_CANDIDATES="${TOP_K_CANDIDATES}" -e QUANTIZATION="${QUANTIZATION}" -e GPU_MEMORY_UTIL="${GPU_MEMORY_UTIL}" -e RETRIEVER_MODEL_NAME="${RETRIEVER_MODEL_NAME}" -e RETRIEVER_INDEX="${RETRIEVER_INDEX}" -e RETRIEVER_GPU_MEM_UTIL="${RETRIEVER_GPU_MEM_UTIL}" -e RETRIEVER_QUERY_MODE="${RETRIEVER_QUERY_MODE}" -e RETRIEVER_MAX_MODEL_LEN="${RETRIEVER_MAX_MODEL_LEN}" -e BATCH_TASK_INDEX="${BATCH_TASK_INDEX:-0}" -e BATCH_TASK_COUNT="${BATCH_TASK_COUNT:-1}" IMAGE_URI
